source.prior_nkr13: 129/192 correct, 0 confident wrong, 63 abstentions vs exact conjunction-aware symbolic tie on previously examined 12 conjunction worlds; do not retune

research_question: Does NKR13's conjunction-specific candidate grammar become overconfident or fail to propose a rule on entirely new, previously unseen Boolean causal operator families; and what can any unrestricted exact learner infer from eight paired intervention contexts without a structural prior?

immutable_protocol.old_warm: 32 source-visible outcomes (all 16 contexts x both actions), old outcome=parity(context & (1<<(world_index%4))) XOR action
immutable_protocol.new_outcome: new_baseline XOR (action AND OPERATOR(world,context)); OPERATOR function kept in independent environment and not imported by learner
immutable_protocol.operator_ids: 0 through 11, exactly one operator per world by enumerated sequence, no post-result world substitution or pruning
immutable_protocol.train_actions: for each train context both a=0 and a=1, exactly 16 new observed outcomes; first action x0 a1, then x0 a0; subsequent 7 contexts a0 then a1
immutable_protocol.cold_queries: both actions on all 8 new contexts per world=16; total 192; never passed to learner
immutable_protocol.noise_control: the existing 4 single-error NKR13 synthetic noise worlds are NOT repeated: their result remains separate completed prior qualification rather than invented new novelty
immutable_protocol.retention: prior warm 32/32 outputs per world after new observations, 384 total
immutable_protocol.learner: NKR13 NativeOperatorDiscovery unchanged source code and its frozen 1..15 positive-conjunction grammar; single immutable public repair bundle/world; if cannot fit or insufficient contradictions, return no new model; preserve original warm bytes
immutable_protocol.baseline: independent unrestricted Boolean-effect truth-table version-space learner: action-0 baseline derived from visible x=0,1,2,4,8 and parity checked on all 8 training contexts; action effect at observed 8 contexts read from paired interventions; for 8 unobserved contexts allow *both* possible output bits independently, 2^8=256 consistent functions; identify outputs on cold a0 via baseline, abstain on cold a1; no source-hidden outcome truth in fitting
immutable_protocol.additional_strong_control: NKR13's original independent exact conjunction symbolic learner from NKR12 is reported if it can fit; when it cannot, report family misspecification rather than silently substitute a stronger model
negative_controls: checkpoint generation produces no accepted model/factual writes
cold labels absent from public intervention source
all 12 hidden operator functions are not a pure nonempty positive conjunction on all 16 contexts
no new original Wikidata source access
unknown result abstention never recoded as correct

thresholds.falsification: At least one NKR13 confidently incorrect cold prediction OR at least one new-world source bundle unable to be represented by any positive-conjunction candidate; preserve both counts separately. Strong unrestricted version-space control must make ZERO confidently wrong predictions with eight unobserved effects and 256 consistent complete functions/world.
thresholds.retention: 384/384 old predictions correct, original checkpoint source bits and legacy YPC1 unchanged
thresholds.science: scientific_pass=false regardless of outcomes because synthetic self-built worlds and arbitrary function class cannot generalize without inductive bias or more interventions
thresholds.metric: native cold correct/covered/confidently wrong/abstain/unsupported, strong unconstrained cold correct/covered/wrong/abstain, observed action budget, source SHA cold restore, all worlds including failure cases, wall time
thresholds.null_policy: If no falsification despite frozen worlds, report no observed limitation; do not change operators, test contexts, action budgets, metric or control after results.
thresholds.interpretation: Even though program-family IDs are hidden, all 12 operators are hand-authored by the experimenter. This is NOT independent authentic causal first-use, not automatic invention of an unrestricted novel operation.
thresholds.next_action: Without priors, at least 8 additional action-1 interventions covering cold contexts are needed to identify their arbitrary effect bits; a separately frozen active-information acquisition protocol is justified only if the bound is confirmed.

engineering.required: full final regression NKR05 + entire root suite + independent G29 at exact final SHA/tree
